risks.note: Management calls global uncertainty the new normal, driven by the Russia-Ukraine and Gaza wars and the ongoing Iran-Israel conflict; these have significantly impacted commodity and logistics markets, causing sharp increases in crude oil and freight costs and exposing global supply chains to continuous disruption. Mitigation is dual sourcing, proactive market monitoring and strategic planning.
risks.risk: Geopolitical conflict and the resulting commodity and logistics shock

risks.note: India remains heavily dependent on naphtha as a feedstock along with imported LPG and propane for downstream chemical production, exposing the industry to global crude, naphtha and LPG price fluctuations. Feedstock availability and pricing will remain a key constraint until India develops access to more affordable domestic gaseous hydrocarbons at scale.
risks.risk: Feedstock dependence and pricing - naphtha, imported LPG and propane

risks.note: The naphtha/LPG dependency creates cost sensitivities and competitive disadvantages compared to regions like the United States, where access to ethane-rich shale gas provides a structural cost advantage - a durable margin headwind for Indian downstream chemical producers.
risks.risk: Structural cost disadvantage versus ethane-advantaged regions

risks.note: The global chemical industry has faced a slowdown since 2022 driven by capacity imbalances and weaker demand across key sectors; after two decades of rapid expansion the industry is recalibrating expectations, with lower margins and reduced value creation becoming the new reality.
risks.risk: Prolonged global chemical industry slowdown and margin compression

risks.note: Significant overstocking and oversupply from China is named as a driver of the industry slowdown, pressuring pricing and demand across key chemical sectors.

FY2025-26 was marked by trade disruptions, supply chain constraints, inflationary pressures and volatility in key raw material markets; the Company relies on multipurpose manufacturing facilities that allow it to pivot using alternate raw materials, and on long term off-take agreements, to absorb this.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility and supply-chain constraints

risks.note: Management notes the policy environment presents a dual impact - while offering fiscal and strategic support for growth through FDI policies, PLI schemes, PCPIR clusters and decarbonization initiatives, it also introduces higher compliance costs for companies.
risks.risk: Rising regulatory and compliance cost from the policy environment

risks.note: Management explicitly maintains strict liquidity to navigate industry cycles, indicating cycle-driven earnings and working-capital risk in a downcycle.
